title: KDA: A Knowledge-Distilled Attacker for Generating Diverse Prompts to Jailbreak LLMs
reasoning: The paper includes a specific evaluation and dataset construction category for 'Ethics (ETH)', defined as topics related to moral values and ethical standards. It benchmarks the success of jailbreak attacks in bypassing LLM safety mechanisms specifically designed to prevent the generation of content that violates these ethical and moral norms.
